newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-RIVER PLATE RETAIN ARGENTINE LEAGUE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIVER PLATE RETAIN ARGENTINE LEAGUE TITLE.

text.p: River Plate eased to a 2-0 victory over Velez Sarsfield on Saturday to retain their Argentine league title.
Uruguayan striker Enzo Francescoli scored both goals, after 12 and 65 minutes, of the decisive match.
The title was sealed in the penultimate round of the league as Newell's Old Boys -- the only team with a chance to knock River off top spot -- lost 4-1 to Ferro Carril Oeste.
River regarded the Velez match a key clash to win considering Velez's strong record in recent years, the side having won the league in 1993 and the Copa Libertadores in 1994.
The defending champions cruised to victory simply enough though and could have scored more, Paraguayan goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert saving a penalty by Francescoli.
"For the penalty I hit the ball very slowly and that's why Chilavert saved it... but at the same time I am very satisfied because I scored the two goals that led to the win," Francescoli said.
